procedures.name: Initialize
procedures.doc: Initializes the codeunit with the starting and ending dates, the G/L Account Mapping Header and the CSV separator.

procedures.name: InitializeDefault
procedures.doc: Simpler initialization method that uses the default CSV separator, default dates and default amount calculation methods.

procedures.name: GenerateFileToBlob
procedures.doc: Generates the Regnskab Basis Accounting file to a blob.

procedures.name: ReadIntoDraft
procedures.doc: Reads an OIOUBL format XML document and converts it into a draft purchase document. This procedure processes Invoice and CreditNote document types and populates the E-Document Purchase Header with the extracted data.

procedures.name: View
procedures.doc: Displays a readable view of the processed E-Document purchase information. This procedure opens a page showing the purchase header and lines in a user-friendly format for review.
